title: Clapclap. Clipclap. Clappyclap.
html_source:
‘Ulysses in its latter episodes plunges us into language as an “ungovernable potency,” taking us beyond the surface and authority of language into the free play of energy that lies behind it’(http://home.earthlink.net/~mdmeighan/thesis.html).

The fugal introduction to this episode illustrates the quote above most abundantly and resembles the soundscape of Finnegans Wake more than any other section of Ulysses.
